s1.body:
Hi {{1}}, Najjuko here. I specialise in Palm Jebel Ali. You’re receiving this because {{2}}. Quick question about your unit: what’s your plan for it right now?

Najjuko · BRN {{3}} · Tap Stop and I’ll delete your details.

a1.text: Thank you {first}. If it helps, I can support you with handover, snagging and getting the home ready to lease when the time comes.

a2.text: Would you like a short Palm Jebel Ali market update every two weeks?

a3.text: Lovely, you will get one update every two weeks. Reply STOP at any time.

endok.text: No problem at all. I am here whenever you need me.

b1.text: Thank you {first}. Is your unit already listed with an agent?

b3.text: Would you consider a time-boxed trial listing with us, 60 to 90 days, removed if it has not sold? I will call you to agree the details.

b4.text: I can prepare a valuation for your unit from the latest Najma market data, at no cost. For context, DLD records show {fact:pja_home_sales}, at a median of {fact:pja_median_psf}.

bh.note: Selling path: call the owner. Nothing agreed yet.
bh.text: Thank you. I will be in touch personally to take it from here.

c1.text: Here is a one-page brief on Palm Springs, the next launch nearby:

c2.text: Would you like a short call to talk it through?

ch.note: Palm Springs: owner asked for a call.
ch.text: Perfect, I will message you to find a time.

d1.text: Of course. May I send you a short market update every two weeks instead?
